title: Apical-in spheroids become motile within a week in low-adhesive liquid culture

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Apical-in spheroids become motile within a week in low-adhesive liquid culture

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Human bronchial epithelial spheroids that are apical-in and non-motile on release from Matrigel become motile by day 7 in low-adhesive liquid culture, with beating cilia on their outer surface; immunostaining shows a large increase in external multiciliated cells between day 0 and day 7.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Results › Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells Self‐Construct into Multicellular Motile Living Architectures

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: This new approach has enabled the originally apical‐in spheroids (that show no motility on day 0 as shown on Figure 1b.1) to became motile by day 7 (Figure 1b.2), featuring highly motile ciliary appendages on the spheroid surface.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Results › Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells Self‐Construct into Multicellular Motile Living Architectures”. Scope: NHBE-derived spheroids in vitro, Anthrobot protocol with retinoic acid

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-04: resolvable-now, resolvability 0.84

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The time, motility, and surface-cilia outcomes are direct and have public supporting observations. Standard video and image analysis can confirm or refute the stated protocol-level result.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Compare day-0 and day-7 displacement, surface-cilia video, and external multiciliated-cell staining in the same protocol cohort.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Not all spheroids may be represented in public media.

Different specimens may supply day-0 and day-7 staining.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data existence: 0.78
analysis feasibility: 0.9
operationalizability: 0.98
data adequacy: 0.68
discriminating power: 0.9

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Motile fraction and external cilia counts are direct variables with an obvious contrast between day 0 and day 7. The paper reports that contrast and places the underlying data with the authors on request. Re-inspecting the published panels is not a reanalysis of the census, so the test waits on the raw counts or a new culture run.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Score the fraction of apical-in spheroids that translocate on day 0 and on day 7 after release into low-adhesive liquid culture, and count external multiciliated cells by acetylated-tubulin staining at the same times. A rise in both motility and external cilia would support the time course; motility without external cilia, or no change by day 7, would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The public videos are examples, not the every-other-day census.

Motility counts and cilia tallies are in figures and are not a deposited table.

Day-7 staining is a separate sample from the tracked spheroids, so the pairing is by cohort rather than by individual.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.28
discriminating power: 0.62
operationalizability: 0.92
data adequacy: 0.22
data existence: 0.26
